name: io.github.ParallaxProtocol/parallax-mcp
title: Parallax Protocol
description: Read-only Parallax PoW chain data: blocks, transactions, mining, supply, explorer and network health

packageArguments.name: --transport
packageArguments.description: Serve MCP over stdio (the image defaults to HTTP)

environmentVariables.name: PARALLAX_MCP_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Parallax JSON-RPC endpoint; a node serving debug, txpool and admin enables more tools

environmentVariables.name: PARALLAX_MCP_GROUPS
environmentVariables.description: Tool groups: chain, mining, explorer, network, mempool, docs, and tx (unsigned transaction tools, off by default)
